# Drifting gizmo

`Gizmo: giz-drifting` `LIVE`

## What it does

Drifts from its own frontmatter in all three ways the check reports. No section names `it-rattles`, so the field
carries an id the document answers nowhere. The second section names `it-purrs`, which the field does not carry. And
that line stands in the middle of its section rather than closing it, so what a reader takes for a footnote is not one.

### The humming part

Sets the pitch, and holds it.

_**Covers:** [giz-behaving].it-hums_

### The purring part

_**Covers:** [giz-behaving].it-purrs_

Sends it to sleep, which is a behaviour nothing asked this gizmo to answer.

[giz-behaving]: behaving.md
